title: ‘The Bachelorette’ Post-Oscars Special Showed How Taylor Frankie Paul Plans to Run Her Dramatic Season
summary: A teaser also aired during ABC’s season 22 special Sunday night, just hours before reports surfaced that production on Paul’s other reality show, 'The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives,' paused amid an alleged domestic incident involving her ex, Dakota Mortensen.
